name: HyperASHS-PMC-T1
shortdesc: MTL subfield segmentation in T1-MRI using PMC 3T atlas
longdesc: Automatic segmentation of MTL subregions and anterior/posterior hippocampus in isotropic T1-weighted 3 Tesla MRI scans, using the Penn Memory Center protocol (Yushkevich et al., 2014)

tags.name: T1-MRI
tags.hint: Roughtly isotropic (e.g., 1x1x1mm^3) T1-weighted MRI scan of the whole brain.
